race.comment: ALL THE STARS (4) was superb from the front on debut before getting a mile back and never featuring second-up at this track. A better barrier this time is a big tick and the booking of Fiore is a good push for his chances. Can sit much closer this time around and he's expected to bounce back in a big way. OSCARS NO GROUCH (1) got a long way back last start from a wide draw but flew home to miss narrowly on the Scarpside at Pinjarra. Likely to get back from the draw once again, but he rates highly on the back of that effort and a repeat performance will see him right in the finish again. FARADIO (2) was tested in Listed grade prior to the break. He's trialled very impressively coming into this and while it's short of his best trip, he can make an impression first-up. NEWHAVEN PRINCE (3) is third-up today now and a peak performance looks on the cards despite a wide alley. GENERAL NAPOLEON (9) can feature on debut with Pike sticking from his latest trial.
